anchors.reading: means over the 1 uM and 10 uM conditions that passed quality control; DNMT has two compounds and PRC2 three, so these are descriptions, not tests

interpretation.boundary: Absence cannot separate a failed perturbation from a mechanism inert at this condition.

quality.rule: both replicate wells with at least 20 cells and matched vehicle

variables.name: rna_shift
variables.derivation: pseudobulk log1p(CP10K) shift against the pooled vehicle of the same line, time and replicate

variables.name: hallmark_activity
variables.derivation: mean rna_shift over MSigDB Hallmark members present; five largest in absolute value

variables.name: cell_cycle
variables.derivation: Tirosh S and G2M module means per cell, averaged per well; g2m_high is the fraction above the vehicle 90th percentile

variables.derivation: cells recovered in the well against the mean vehicle well on the same plate; a proxy, not viability
